Filter in place, nothing extra gets through
The &6MEGA&r co-processor gives four threads per block instead of one. Eight blocks, and an order for &eAntimatter&r stops taking all evening.
Craft one each of the 4k, 16k and 64k cells.
Extract pulls, Insert pushes, Sensor only watches and clicks out redstone. Stock watches the count: it keeps a set amount in the receiver and delivers nothing beyond it.
The housing is made of sky steel; the component, of a 256k cell and an Accumulation Processor. From there the tiers climb the same ladder: 1M, 4M, 16M, 64M, 256M.
Set up one card just right, and the cloner copies the settings onto the rest, while the holder carries a dozen cards as a single item. By the third node you'll understand why this was here.
Filters here are separate items: by list, by count, by mod, by tag, by NBT. The filter goes into the card, the card into a node face.
Craft an ME Chemical Cell Housing and a 1k ME Chemical Storage Cell
It's a way to get the network through a tight spot: one cable down a corridor instead of four dense ones. But the tunnel itself also sits on channels; there's no free lunch here.
The conveyor is laid down as a track and carries items along, plus anything that steps onto it. Direction is set when you place it; slopes up and down are made by placing it at an angle.
The condenser turns items into nothing. Without a cell inside it's just a trash can, and that's its most common use: hook a low-priority storage bus up to it, and overflow stops being your problem.
And a small bonus on top: a ten percent chance that a batch yields its output twice. The rock is endless, but how many atoms you manage to pull out of it is a matter of technique.

An upgrade sets two things at once: how many items go per transfer and how often. Basic stirs rarely and moves a little at a time, Improved is noticeably livelier, Advanced handles a whole row of machines, Ultimate the entire workshop.

Sixteen times faster than the regular one, and sixteen hundred FE per tick. This isn't a machine anymore, it's a workshop: you'll have to build power generation for it instead of hanging it on the same cable.
Build an ME IO Port.
Stock means “keep this many”
Judge by the backlog, not by looks. If rock is piling up in the Dissolver's output slots, the pipe can't keep up, and no second Dissolver will fix that.
A regular connector sticks to one face and runs at one speed. The advanced one moves items noticeably faster and can access different faces of the same block.
The cell sits between them and smooths out the difference. Without it the terminal will go dark every time the Combiner gets to work.
All the same: the pattern as a Processing Pattern, the provider right against the machine, blocking mode on. The addon covers exactly two machines, and this is the second one.
So feel free to close the book on this quest and come back later. Everything below will still be here, and the rest of the chapter doesn't depend on it.
This is literally real lithography: a silicon wafer, metal on top, a conductor in between. Real life just has no redstone; copper does that job there.

An inverted export bus with an empty list exports absolutely everything from the machine. One card instead of listing a hundred and eighteen elements, and you won't have to extend the list after every new chapter.
Craft an Overflow Destruction Card.
The whole branch rests on this processor. Print extras right away: you have Inscribers, and a provider is great at feeding them while you're busy with something else.

For silicon, oxygen and iron it's the same logic as the &6MEGA&r bulk cell, only several chapters cheaper. And don't let the pearl and the eye in the recipe scare you: both are already assembled from elements, like everything else here.
Craft two Import Buses, two Export Buses and one Storage Bus.
A logic channel switches something off
Craft a MEGA Pattern Provider and a MEGA Crafting Unit.

The filter lives in the same window as the upgrade. Whitelist means “only this”, blacklist means “everything except”. Next to it you can toggle round-robin distribution: the pipe stops dumping everything into the first receiver it finds and hands things out in turn.

And right there is a counter for “how much to leave in the source”. You'll need it sooner than you think: without it, the pipe will scoop out of the Dissolver not only the output but also the rock you loaded into the input.
Priorities set, elements are where they belong
There will be no meteorite
One order occupies one CPU entirely, from start to finish. While it's working through a batch of antimatter, your order for one single wire stands in line and waits.
The frame itself does nothing. It's just that without it, not a single machine in the mod can be built.
Patterns: quartz glass, glowstone dust from Chapter 3, certus and iron. The terminal goes on the cable next to the regular one.
Not a single pipe
Porcelain under voltage
The extractor is placed facing a log and slowly squeezes latex out of it. Latex with water in the processing unit gives Dry Rubber, and rubber in a furnace gives plastic.
It only gets worse: every new chapter adds types, not quantity. &6AE2&r tiers end at 256k, and they run out on volume, not on variety. That's exactly why the whole branch below exists.
A multiblock. The size and build order are in the mod's book; it's available in JEI and walks through the tiers in order.
Wood can be synthesized too
Where the network really puts things
The ring links two networks across any distance and across dimensions: one half here, the other on Mars, and between them a &esingularity&r and a matter emitter.
This is exactly the case the first half of the chapter was written for. The &eDissolver&r runs by itself, the export bus hauls by itself, the condenser counts by itself. You just leave and come back.
For three chapters you've been taking the world apart by hand. From here on, it takes itself apart.

&6So we struck the dies ourselves.&r Seven Sky Stone blocks for the body, an iron block for the core, and one material in the middle depending on the press: silicon, a block of redstone, a certus crystal, a block of diamond.

Things that pull: a pipe with an extraction upgrade, an XNet channel in Extract mode, an &6AE2&r provider. The machine exposes its inventory honestly, so you can always reach in and take things out. It just never makes the first move.

The energy one is especially nice: input at the reactor, outputs all over the workshop, and not a single &6Powah&r cable in sight. Just check the per-tick limit: there is one, and by the fourth Inscriber you'll run into it.
Craft an ME Pattern Access Terminal and a Crafting Monitor.

Here's the arithmetic. Every type in use eats eight bytes of overhead, then it's eight items per byte. An empty 1k takes &b8,128&r identical items, but if you stuff it with all sixty-three types, there's room for just over four thousand items in total.
The &eDissolver&r spends fifty ticks per batch. The Industrial one takes twelve: four times as fast, on four times the power.

The tunnel runs a whole bundle of channels along a single cable: the input takes up to thirty-two, the outputs hand them out. The Memory Card remembers the input and sets up every output with one click.

The &eDissolver&r extracts atoms, the &eCombiner&r puts them together into substances, the &eCompactor&r squeezes them sixteen at a time into dust, and dust is what ordinary machines work with: smelters, enrichers, presses.
The pipe itself doesn't pull anything. The upgrade does, placed in the side of the pipe that touches the machine: hit that side with the wrench, set Extract mode, put a Basic Upgrade inside.

The Universal Pipe carries items, fluids, energy and gas along a single line. It saves space and nerves, but each type needs its own upgrade: put a Basic on items, and the fluids are still standing still.
An addon instead of a second machine

The funny part is that your log was itself synthesized from cellulose. The mod faithfully models tapping rubber from a tree, and the tree here is just as much a chemical product as steel. Work out for yourself which is cheaper: this route or the Combiner straight from PVC.
Stage: industry
The peak of &6AE2&r and the “tech” line of the &eCertificate&r transcript.
By the end of the chapter you'll have five Combiners and fifty patterns. Hunting for the right one by walking from block to block is something you'll do exactly once.
After 256k
Same tiers: four and sixteen times, fifty FE per tick at base. No bonus: changing the form doesn't create matter, it only rewrites it.
Don't put crafting patterns in it. Molecular Assemblers stay on the regular provider: the same split you already arrived at back with blocking mode, only now it's not advice, it's a requirement.
Crystals are grown in an orb
Refined Storage was left out of the pack on purpose. Two storage systems mean two incompatible autocrafting logics and the eternal question “why can't the terminal see it”.
The cure is not size but number. Two small CPUs are almost always more useful than one big one, and the terminal stops getting stuck on trifles.
Build and start a Reactor (Hardened).
The “cell and gate” pair moves energy without a single cable. Put the cell by the reactors, the gate where you need power, and link them with a card.
Print 8 Energy Processors.

But there is cellulose. Two pieces and you get a log; or a sapling, if you'd like to watch it grow. Wood here is just as much a product of synthesis as steel.
Build an Industrial Dissolver

The Import Bus goes on the machine's face and pulls its output straight into the network: the same pulling as with Pipez, only without a chest in the middle. The Export Bus does the opposite and puts rock from storage into the Dissolver's input.
Build a Powah reactor and run it on uraninite.
Perfect for iron, silicon and oxygen. For anything else it's money down the drain: it simply doesn't have the other sixty-two types.
Fluix doesn't exist
One cable instead of all the wires

You're putting the world back together from its own atoms. You broke the rock down into iron, silicon and carbon and put it back together; it all adds up to the last atom, and out comes the same dead stone.
The Dissolver runs without me
Kaolinite is the mineral of the white clay that porcelain is made from. Ceramics really are the main insulator in power engineering, so the recipe is honest.
That's why it has tiers too, with the same arithmetic: four and sixteen times faster, energy in proportion, price by the number of machines replaced.
A co-processor doesn't speed up a single operation. It lets several different ones run at the same time within one order: while the assembler spins up plastic, the Combiner is already mixing PVC.
&eCombiner&r: &b16&r atoms make one ingot. The most direct bridge in the whole pack; there's nothing to translate.

You were given the four presses because there was nowhere to get them. The fifth one is a different story, and it comes from an unexpected place: an &6AE2&r Charger, an iron block inside, a little energy, and out comes the Inscriber Energy Press.
Craft a Laser Node, two Laser Connectors and a Laser Wrench.
Speed costs energy
Throw it in the water

The conversion one also hands things out: click it and get a stack in your hand, put it back and the network takes it. A wall of these monitors over your workstation replaces half your trips to the terminal.
&eCombiner&r: &b32&r polyvinyl chloride for one plastic. The &eDissolver&r gives back six; the loss is built in on purpose so that “craft it and break it down” doesn't turn into duplication.
Set a card to Stock mode and keep exactly one stack in the machine.

Rubber from synthetic wood
Inscriber: the calculation press on top, the engineering press at the bottom, a &eSingularity&r between them. The presses aren't consumed; the singularity is.
Just a lot

A quarter million into one point
One quirk of the extraction upgrade: if items pile up on the belt and nobody takes them, it stops itself. Don't panic, it's not broken, it's an overflow brake.

It costs exactly four Dissolvers, so you don't get throughput for free. What you get is something else: one block standing where four did. Four power feeds become one, four pipes become one, four chests become one.
Build an Energizing Orb and four Energizing Rods.
&eCombiner&r: silica with manganese. The same SiO₂ as in Chapter 3, plus a coloring metal: quartz always gets its color from trace impurities.
Build a Dissolution Chamber and make any addon in it.
One order, one memory
This is how you automate everything the addon doesn't reach: the &eDissolver&r, the &eAtomizer&r, the Liquifier.
The fourth channel type carries nothing. It counts: how many items are in a chest, how many ticks have passed, how many times something has happened. Then it outputs a signal on its own color.
It goes into a break in the cable and, on a redstone signal, cuts off everything beyond it. The inverted one does the opposite: it works without a signal and shuts off with one.
Put an Item Card into the node face that looks at the machine.

Twenty-five percent for double output. The number looks modest until you do the math: the endgame needs about two and a half million dissolved blocks, and with the Cascade one that becomes about two million. Those five hundred thousand blocks you won't have to dig up: you simply won't need them.

Craft a Hardened Capacitor and a Hardened Energy Cable.

Uraninite, a.k.a. UO₂

One instead of sixteen
The Compactor takes orders
Basic is enough for one machine. For a farm take Improved or Advanced, or the pipe will become the bottleneck before the machine does.
Seven ingredients and one furnace
The card lives in the node

The chamber is the only way to make addons, and an addon plugs into almost any machine in the mod. Speed speeds things up, Efficiency lowers energy use, Processing increases the batch per operation, Range widens the working area.

The connector goes right onto the machine's face, and the cable runs to the controller. In the controller you set up an Item channel: the machine's connector on Extract, the chest's connector on Insert.
Addon built and installed in the machine

With a cell inside, it accumulates. Two hundred and fifty-six items give a Matter Ball, two hundred and fifty-six thousand give a &eSingularity&r. That number isn't a typo, and a Dissolver running without you can handle it just fine.
Sky Stone is assembled in the &eCombiner&r from lithium and silica, and certus comes from there too; you have both from this chapter. So the press is now an honest item, not a gift.
Uraninite will run out before you do
Input can be anything, even a hopper on top: the machine's input works fine, you just can't use it in reverse. Output only through something set to Extract.
63 types, not 63 stacks
Build an ME Drive, four 1k cells and a terminal.
Pull it out yourself

An upgrade is simply clicked onto the conveyor on the side where you need it, and removed with a sneak-click. The extraction upgrade pulls from the inventory it's pressed against; the insertion upgrade does the opposite and pushes into it.
Craft an ME Crafting Terminal.
A 1k cell holds &b63&r different item types, not &b63&r stacks. A million iron atoms is one type. A hundred different elements, one of each, is a hundred types and the entire cell at once.

&6Applied Mekanistics&r teaches the &6AE2&r network to see what it couldn't see before: &6Mekanism&r chemicals. Hydrogen, oxygen, chlorine, slurries: everything that flows through Mekanism pipes now sits in the network right next to your ingots.
Build an ME Interface and attach a Storage Bus from a second network to it.
A crafting table right in the terminal
Craft an ME Pattern Encoding Terminal and 32 Blank Patterns.

The Cell Workbench writes a list into a cell: what it's allowed to store. A partitioned cell won't accept anything else, and it's the only way to make the network put elements where you want them, not wherever the first free spot is.
If it won't connect, check the side configuration menu of the machine itself: that face has to be open to the outside.
Bytes, not stacks
Card on the right face, output is moving
A cell for the &eSingularity&r in the condenser, a storage bus on the condenser at the lowest priority, and everything surplus goes there. Two hundred and fifty-six thousand items, and one comes out.
The rule from the first quest hasn't gone anywhere. It's just that now the one who pulls is the same one who placed the order.
Craft an ME Wireless Access Point, a Wireless Terminal and two Wireless Boosters.
&8You pay once, then copy for free: the press in the top slot of the Inscriber, iron in the middle; the press itself isn't consumed.&8

Eight steel blocks through a tree of PVC, elements and ingots is hundreds of intermediate operations. Give it memory to spare: you can't add more to a running CPU, so you'd have to cancel the order and calculate it again.
The &eCompactor&r lives by the rule “sixteen atoms, one unit of substance”: sixteen iron make an ingot, sixteen silicon make a dust.
Build both Compactor tiers
Decant the cell

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.002: You can see the symptom coming: the temperature keeps climbing instead of holding. The controller has a semi-automatic shutdown: it kills the reactor when the temperature drops below two and a half thousand and saturation reaches ninety-nine percent. Turn it on right away, not after the first pop.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.00a: Bring back 32 magma blocks and 64 basalt
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.02f: Route the two fission products into separate chests
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.03a: While you're here: glowstone is the best source of phosphorus in the game, and you'll need four blocks of soul sand for the Wither anyway.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.03d: Catalyst: a Wyvern Core, with four draconium ingots and four Wyvern Energy Controllers around it. Eight million FE per craft, and the injectors must be tier two, or the recipe won't even show up.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.046: Crafting table: osmium and platinum around the edges, blaze powder in the center. Four casings per craft.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.071: Got it: one reactor, one recipe, filter on the input
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.072: So a moderator always pays off in energy and always costs you in heat, and the whole reactor design is a trade between two numbers. Nobody stops you from surrounding a cell with moderator on all six sides. Cooling it afterwards is another question.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.080: You no longer need wires between the base and the Energy Core, and it's not about looks. A cable means chunks that have to stay loaded; a crystal sees its partner on its own.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.090: Provider on the input, import bus on the output
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.092: Try it on a real example. The second reactor quest asks for five hundred and twelve atoms each of osmium and platinum. One thousand twenty-four reactions is three quarters of an hour of nonstop work, if you have one chamber and it never once jams onto another recipe.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.0a4: Forty-five and a half million FE. For comparison, your Fusion Chamber's buffer is one hundred thousand, so this single block holds four hundred and fifty of those. And this is the lowest of eight tiers.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.0ba: Enrichment is just purity, measured by mass. In our trade, purity is something to brag about; in the nuclear trade, it's what treaties get signed over, and the line is drawn at twenty percent: below it is reactor fuel, above it is a conversation with very different people.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.0bd: The only trip beyond your own world. You bring back a star, and you never leave again
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.0c3: One rod is two blaze powder. The casings need seventeen powder, which is nine rods. Another nine go into three Fission Cores. Sixteen is just barely enough; twenty-four means you won't have to come back.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.0c9: Build a Draconic fusion crafting setup and run the first craft
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.0fb: In this pack lead drops from nowhere else, and Reactor Glass is lead plus silica. Thirty-two magma blocks won't be enough: a chamber needs about a hundred. Basalt also gives magnesium oxide, the very one you paid for obsidian with.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.0fd: Place a Flux Gate and limit one line
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.10b: Crimson and warped forests. A stem counts as a log: it makes planks, and planks make everything else, from crafting tables, bookshelves and chests to Draconic's Potentiometer.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.10c: The Energy Core grows out of other mods' storage: the cells come from the Induction Matrix, and every Wyvern Energy Controller now holds two &6Powah&r Blazing Capacitors.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.10f: Why it's here. Mobs do spawn on the plain, but chasing them around at night is no job for someone who owns a reactor. Cursed Earth gathers the spawning into one spot, the Mob Grinder kills and picks up the drops, eighty FE per point of health.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.111: There's no wood in your world at all. You can synthesize it (cellulose in the Compactor makes a log), but here it simply grows. And grows back: nylium, fungus, bone meal, and a second later there's a twenty-block stem in front of you. The Compactor makes the bone meal too.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.11a: Did the math: fifteen thousand FE and two and a half seconds per atom
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.125: Awakened draconium is made by fusion crafting: four draconium blocks as the catalyst, six cores around them and a Dragon Heart among them. Fifty million FE for four blocks.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.14c: In stars, it all ends at nickel: past that point fusion stops producing energy and starts demanding it. Your chamber doesn't care, it has a power outlet.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.153: There are no diamonds in this world. There is carbon: four atoms make graphite, eight graphite make graphite dust, sixteen dust in the Compactor make a diamond. Five hundred and twelve carbon atoms apiece, and no other way.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.15a: There are no bridges to isotopes in this pack, on purpose: separation is what the nuclear tier is all about, and an “elements → uranium-&b235&r” bridge would cancel the whole mod.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.161: Count &b65&r, not &b62&r. Sixty-two go into the walls, three more into the ports: the energy, input and output blocks are crafted from a casing. That's &b17&r crafts in total.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.164: Draconic Evolution treats diamonds as consumables. A Draconium Core takes one, the Fusion Crafting Core four, each injector two, each stabilizer four. The first set eats close to fifty.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.18c: If it won't come alive, it's almost always one of three things. The controller faces inward; the cores are off center; a casing sits where glass is required.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.1b9: Both chambers are built the same way: &b62&r casings, &b36&r glass, three ports, three cores. You paid for the first reactor by dissolving stone at seven percent per block; you'll pay for the second with two recipes. That's why fusion comes before fission in this book: otherwise you'd have to pay the bill twice.
Optional: it doesn't unlock anything further.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.1c8: The Dragon Heart drops from the Ender Dragon. The Ender Dragon lives in the End, and the End is the next chapter. There's no more draconium ore in the End, same as everywhere else, but the dragon itself gives about sixty-four dust.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.1f6: The catalyst goes into the core, the ingredients one per injector. Power goes into the injectors, not the core; that's the first thing everyone trips over.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.1f8: Next, the gold goes into uranium: Al (&b13&r) + Au (&b79&r) = &b92&r.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.1ff: Understand that an element is a path, not a recipe
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.221: The Nether isn't empty because of that. Netherrack gives germanium, basalt magnesium oxide, magma lead, glowstone phosphorus, and blazes, wither skeletons and ghasts drop their own loot. Nothing to mine, plenty to dissolve.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.224: Don't hang ten chambers on one bus
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.228: With even numbers you don't notice: uranium gives two palladium, identical halves. With odd ones they differ. Sodium, number eleven, splits into carbon and boron. Gold into zirconium and yttrium, and those are two different items in one chest.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.265: Nether fortresses. If you come across a blaze spawner, don't break it: fence it in and live next door.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.26c: Two diamonds, a Draconium Core, five stone and a &ePrecision Mechanism&r from &6Create&r in the center, where the iron block used to be. The Draconium injector is the lowest of the four tiers, and it's where everything starts.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.288: A real moderator does exactly the same thing: it slows neutrons down so they have time to split nuclei instead of flying past. That's exactly why graphite was chosen for the world's first reactor. It's also what later burned at Windscale and Chernobyl.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.28b: Ancient debris used to sit at heights &b8&r to &b22&r. In season two there is no ore in any world, and no debris in the Nether's walls either.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.2a3: A draconium ingot, a diamond, a blaze rod and a Draconium Core, diagonally.

Here's what it looks like. You set up gold fusion and went to bed. The pipe delivered the wrong thing. For six hours the reactor ate power and made something of its own. No error, no message, just an empty chest in the morning.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.2bf: The Flux Gate goes into a break in the cable and lets through exactly as much FE per tick as you tell it to. Sounds pointless right up until the first time the Energy Core gives away everything it had and one machine with a greedy buffer sucks it dry in a second.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.2c6: The flint and steel is in the reward, so you don't have to hunt for it. You can make flint yourself if you like: three silicon dioxide into the &eCompactor&r. But if you've made it this far, you have better things to do.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.2cd: Summon the Wither and take its star
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.2ce: Without all three ports the multiblock will form, but it will stay dead.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.2da: The heart of the second setup
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.2dc: Iron, draconium, a diamond sword, a Wyvern Energy Controller and any head. You have a head: you've already hauled wither skeleton skulls around, and one of them can be spared from the Wither.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.2dd: Twenty-six blocks is two hundred thirty-four ingots, which is almost two thousand atoms of neodymium and a thousand each of thorium and protactinium. No ore, no veins: the Fusion Chamber now works on draconium nonstop.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.2fe: This stage gates the Fusion Chamber Controller and the Fusion Core, and the &eQuantum Compressor&r. It's easy to tell whether this is your case: the quest is completed, the reward is claimed, but these items still pop out of your inventory and can't be picked up off the ground. That means the grant command didn't fire.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.30d: A depleted assembly isn't garbage. The reprocessor breaks it back down into isotopes, and among them appears something the original fuel never had: plutonium, neptunium, americium.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.314: Good news: while you're hacking away at the Nether's basement, that same netherrack goes into the Dissolver for germanium. The “One chance in twenty-seven” quest will complete itself if you don't throw the rock away.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.375: Got it: no ore in the Nether either
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.38d: Twice as much from the same uranium
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.3af: The second use is priorities. Put a gate with a low limit in front of a secondary line, and it stops eating the main line's lunch. It's the only way in the pack to manage energy by flow rather than after the fact.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.3b1: Portal area is capped at sixty-five thousand blocks (that's two hundred fifty-six by two hundred fifty-six), and no portal block can be more than two hundred fifty-six blocks from the receptacle. In other words, if you want, you can fit your whole base into a portal like that.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.3dc: Casing, glass, a port, a controller and fuel cells. Anywhere from three to twenty-six blocks per side, and the shape is a box, not necessarily a cube.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.3eb: Four draconium ingots, two &eAdvanced Induction Cells&r from &6Mekanism&r, two Wyvern Energy Controllers and a Wyvern Core. One block.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.3ff: The mechanism can't be made by hand, only on an assembly line from the &6Create&r chapter. Until the first mechanism is done there, you can't build an injector.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.40a: Fe (&b26&r) + Sn (&b50&r) = Os (&b76&r). Ni (&b28&r) + Sn (&b50&r) = Pt (&b78&r). Two lines instead of fifteen thousand blocks of andesite.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.40c: On top of that, Nether wood doesn't burn. In a dimension with lava underfoot, that's no small thing.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.413: Nitro Crystal, Nitro Capacitor, Spirited Battery: the mod's whole ladder in one item.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.415: A network is built from two ends. A &eFlux Plug&r goes next to a generator or storage and pulls energy into the network, a &eFlux Point&r goes next to a machine and delivers it. One network can have any number of plugs and points; distance and worlds don't matter.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.41f: Three hundred and twenty-eight blocks of redstone
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.423: The Nether and the End are vanilla in this pack. Mobs here don't wait for nightfall, they live here all the time: bring armor, food and blocks. And write down the portal's coordinates.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.449: Plus seventeen to energy, plus thirty-three to heat
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.460: Cable goes only into the Reactor Energy block. Feeding any other face of the multiblock is pointless.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.46f: The fission reactor will ask for the same graphite line later: the &6NuclearCraft&r moderator is a Graphite Block. Build it once, and build it big.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.49e: It's also your first look at Draconic's module grid: the capacitor has four by four slots, and capacity modules go into them. From here the grid only grows, and all of the mod's late-game gear is built on it.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.4ab: &b4&r. Three Fusion Cores, stacked one on top of another, dead center.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.4bd: Build a Mob Grinder and start your first mob farm
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.4cb: From tier five on, plain stabilizers aren't enough: the interface will ask for advanced ones. But tier five is still a hundred and fifty draconium blocks away, so that's not tonight's problem.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.4d7: Three chambers on one bus is fine. Ten is exactly the case the quest across the way warns you about.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.4e9: The rock is fourteen percent carbon, the second most common element after iron. So the issue isn't rarity, it's throughput: fifty diamonds is twenty-five thousand atoms, and you'll never gather that by hand.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.4ef: Two draconium ingots and two &eElite Control Circuits&r from &6Mekanism&r in the corners, four Draconium Cores, a &eNether Star&r in the center. Crafting table, no fusion needed.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.501: So: caution, not a ban. Each chamber gets its own channel. Connect the first pair while standing next to them, and rejoin the world right away: rolling back one chunk is cheaper than rolling back the whole base. And make a backup before you roll out a farm.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.50a: The first mobs at your home
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.50d: Connect the chamber through a Provider in blocking mode
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.510: The peak of &6Powah&r and a line in the “Transcript: energy” of your &eCertificate&r.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.516: You create the network in any device's interface, and connect the rest to it there. Priority decides who gets fed first; the limit keeps one machine from drinking everything.
Click the checkmark and claim the reward: the stage will be granted again. If you already have it, nothing changes: granting it twice is harmless.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.51d: On its own the core is useless. Without injectors it just glows prettily.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.541: A pylon stores nothing. It's just a door: it faces the Energy Core, stands not far from it, and switches between input and output with a click.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.54a: Crystals are made from Wyvern Energy Controllers and diamonds, and linked to each other with the binder, the very one you made and forgot about.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.550: So any element is not a recipe but a path. Platinum is one step from iron if you have tin. Uranium is three from copper: copper and tin give gold, gold and aluminum give uranium. The path to the lanthanides is longer, and every step costs chamber time and your energy.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.551: The ring doesn't have to be a ring. Injectors can sit at different heights and different distances, as long as each one faces the center. A sphere looks nice, but a heap works too.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.562: Then the separator, and far more &b238&r will come out of it. Natural uranium is exactly &b0&r.&b72&r%% &b235&r; the pack made nothing up here. For the sake of those seven tenths of a percent, Oak Ridge at its peak ate about one percent of all the electricity in the USA.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.56d: You can't get through this by hand: the whole volume falls on the automation from chapter four. And it's the only time: after the first Fusion Chamber, both metals will be made from iron and tin.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.578: The element's name says it all: phosphorus is Greek for light-bearer. It was discovered by boiling down urine in search of gold, and what came out was a white wax that glowed in the dark all by itself. There was no gold in it.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.588: Draconium Infused Obsidian: blaze powder, obsidian and draconium dust. The frame is built from it, the Dislocator Receptacle goes into the frame, and a bound point-to-point dislocator goes into the receptacle.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.591: Yellowcake is uranium oxide, U3O8, the very first thing real mines produce: the ore is crushed, leached, precipitated and dried. It was called yellow after the color of the first batches; modern yellowcake is more often green or black, but the name stuck.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.599: So the sorting has to happen outside: a pipe with a filter, an &6AE2&r bus, a hopper with a sorter, anything. There's no separation inside the chamber, and if the stream goes into a shared chest, you'll get a mix that you'll then have to sort out by hand yourself.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.5a2: The rules live in the pack config, not inside the mod, so other people's designs from the internet may not work here. Read the tooltip on the block itself, not a three-year-old guide.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.5b9: Fourteen, not ten: ten is enough for a cornerless frame exactly once. Portals go out, pickaxes hit the wrong block.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.5bf: The mod has two blocks that save you an evening: the designer draws the layout right in its interface, and the builder lays it out from the blueprint. There's no shame in using them. The shame is rebuilding an eleven-by-eleven by hand for the fourth time.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.5ea: Crush redstone between bedrock and obsidian
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.5f9: Read what the Nether offers without ore
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.5ff: This is the second crafting setup in this chapter, and it works the other way around. In an &6Alchemistry&r chamber the recipe is set by what's inside. Here the recipe is set by what stands outside, and the center holds the catalyst: the item that turns into the result at the end.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.608: In the Dissolver, debris gives &b16&r tungsten and &b16&r carbon: by this pack's chemistry, netherite scrap turned out to be tungsten carbide, the stuff drill bits and armor-piercing cores are made of. Now the road runs backwards. Scrap is built in the &eCombiner&r from carbon and nobelium, and debris on the &6Avaritia&r Sculk Crafting Table from four scrap and crying obsidian. Nobelium is chapter six fusion, so the tungsten for &6NuclearCraft&r will come from there too.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.611: &cFlux devices don't load chunks:&r that's disabled on the server. The network works wherever chunks are loaded, so keep your generators and machines in loaded chunks.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.629: Besides, this is lead glass, the same material as the viewing windows of hot cells and crystal glassware. It's worth looking at what goes on inside at least once.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.64c: &cThere is no lava in this world&r, and no lava bucket to get anywhere. That leaves the &eCombiner&r.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.650: Three hundred FE per tick, fifty ticks per reaction. Fifteen thousand FE per atom, two and a half seconds each, fourteen hundred atoms an hour from one chamber.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.656: The reactor builds up a million units of heat, and then it melts down. Explosions are disabled on the server: there won't be a crater, just a pop with no destruction and a dead reactor. The pop does still hit everyone standing nearby.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.65b: Fusion: silicon plus silicon. Silicon is the second most common element under your feet.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.66d: In this pack the two Dielectric Pastes are replaced with &6NuclearCraft&r ELITE PLATES. Together with the Fusion Core above, that makes a chain across three energy mods: &6Mekanism&r → NuclearCraft → &6Powah&r.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.67a: Your first real fusion craft. Catalyst: a Draconium injector. Around it: a Wyvern Core, two diamonds, two &eDesh Plates&r from the Moon, two Draconium Cores and a Draconium Block. Thirty-two thousand FE for the lot.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.67b: Tier five: ninety draconium blocks and eighty redstone. Tier six: a hundred fifty and a hundred seventy-eight. Tier seven: two hundred ten and three hundred twenty-eight.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.6a0: Gather 256 atoms each of osmium and platinum, that's 16 ingots of each
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.6a6: The chamber does have a recipe lock, but it's held in place by your discipline, not its own. Let one stray element in and the recipe silently switches, and nobody will tell you.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.6aa: The Provider goes on the input port and runs in blocking mode: until the previous batch is picked up, no new one is sent. So at any moment the chamber holds exactly the two elements you need and nothing else. There's physically nothing for it to switch to.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.6c3: The dust smelts into an ingot in an ordinary furnace. From there everything is as before, except the ingot now costs atoms instead of a pickaxe.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.6de: &eCombiner&r: lead oxide plus silicon dioxide. Lead from magma blocks, silica from anything.
Thirty-two germanium is four blaze powder, and a chamber needs seventeen. The neighboring blaze rod quest covers the same need at half the cost, so don't go overboard with the digging.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.6e2: Hitting a fireball back is the cheapest way to kill a ghast and the only one that works at range without a bow. You can miss forever, the fireballs are free.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.6e8: You can't get here too early: the fix only unlocks after the quest that grants the stage in the first place.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.6f8: Got it: awakened draconium waits for the dragon
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.6ff: Nether fortresses only. Without Looting the chance is about &b2.5&r%%, with Looting III twice that. It's the difference between an evening and a week.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.716: Tier two: six draconium blocks around the core, in a cross. Two hundred seventy-three million.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.71d: Each next one is another star
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.72a: Four draconium ingots, an Eye of Ender, two emeralds, a Draconium Core, a diamond. Two pylons per craft, exactly as many as you need: one for input, one for output.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.75b: The neighboring quest told you not to feed the chamber from a shared stream. Here's a way to automate it anyway and not wake up to an empty chest.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.75c: One dust dissolves into exactly four phosphorus, no dice rolls, no misses. The white rock under your base is one point two percent phosphorus, so the same four atoms take about three hundred blocks. One cluster of glowstone covers a year's needs in a minute.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.762: It all starts with &eFlux Dust&r, and that isn't made on a crafting table but out in the world. Dig through the antimatter down to bedrock and drop redstone into the hole. Place obsidian one block higher, so the redstone lies between it and the bedrock, and hit the obsidian. The redstone turns into flux.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.766: Don't throw it away. In &6NuclearCraft&r depleted uranium goes into casings, barrels, batteries and the fuel assemblies themselves: a low-enriched assembly holds more 238 than 235, and it's the 238 that makes up the bulk in the reactor.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.7b7: If something else pops out, you need the fix from another chapter. Chapter &b2&r: the &eAtomizer&r, the &eLiquifier&r and the Industrial tiers of &6Alchemistry&r machines. Chapter &b3&r: the ME Controller, the Molecular Assembler and the Pattern Provider. Chapter &b4&r: the Cascade tiers of &6Alchemistry&r machines and everything for the fission reactor. Chapter &b5&r: the Fusion Chamber Controller and Fusion Core, the &eQuantum Compressor&r. Chapter &b6&r: the Ultimate tables from &6Extended Crafting&r. Chapter &b7&r: the Antimatter Shard and &eAntimatter&r itself.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.7d0: Glass is optional: wherever the book shows glass, you can put a casing. Except a casing costs osmium and platinum, and glass costs lead and sand. The difference is about two orders of magnitude.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.7e3: Four diamonds in the corners, a Particle Generator in the center. Four of them, and always four, no matter how many tiers you build later.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.7ea: The chamber has no choice: every element has exactly one split, and it always takes the first matching recipe. You can't make uranium split into krypton and barium, not with settings and not with a script, so plan your chains around that.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.7ec: Gather 178 redstone blocks for tier six
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.7f0: Withering is cured with milk, and wither skeletons reach farther with their swords than it looks.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.7f2: In season one, &edraconium&r ore lay in the Nether's basement, the only ore in the whole pack. In season two it's in neither the Nether nor the End: there is no ore in any world.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.7fe: Stabilizers go on the axes out from the Energy Core's center, at equal distances, facing it. Until they're there, or while they stand crooked, the core's interface says the configuration is invalid and the core won't form, and you get no hint of what exactly is wrong.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.813: JEI will show you a star recipe in the &eCombiner&r: &b64&r mendelevium, &b64&r titanium, &b64&r lutetium, &b64&r dysprosium. The recipe is real, but lutetium lives in the End, and the End is chapter six. On the plus side, printing stars later will be cheaper than farming them: printing takes two skulls, summoning takes three.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.816: Craft three ports: energy, input, output
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.81b: Further down this branch: americium for radioisotope generators, and curium and californium for fuels that chapter five can't reach. But the reprocessor is worth placing now: it pays for itself with the very first reactor.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.81f: Start up a tier one Energy Core
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.84a: Each one is a casing plus a couple of blocks: redstone for energy, hoppers for input, dispensers for output.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.85a: The Dislocator itself: blaze powder, draconium dust and an Eye of Ender. The point-to-point one: two Dislocators, a Draconium Core and a ghast tear. You have tears from the neighboring trip, and this seems to be the only reason you went after them.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.865: Same separator, different dust: ten thorium dust give nine thorium-232 and one thorium-230.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.873: Hook up power and make sure there's enough
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.883: Beyond awakened comes chaos, and that's even further out. Chaos Shards drop from the guardian on floating islands that generate once every ten thousand blocks. The Draconic Reactor, the staff and the whole chaotic tier hang on that, and they have no business in chapter five.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.89c: Now do the math. One casing craft takes &b4&r osmium ingots and &b4&r platinum and yields &b4&r casings. You need &b65&r casings counting the ports, that is &b17&r crafts, that is &b68&r ingots of each, that is &b1,088&r atoms of each. At seven percent that's around fifteen thousand blocks of andesite. And as much diorite again.

Each heat sink has its own placement rule, and without it, it doesn't work. Water wants a cell or a moderator next to it. Gold wants water and redstone at the same time. Diamond: water and quartz. Iron: gold. Obsidian: two glowstone, strictly on opposite sides.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8a2: First, the uranium itself. Copper and tin give gold, gold and aluminum give uranium: Al (&b13&r) + Au (&b79&r) = &b92&r. Sixteen atoms in the &eCombiner&r make an ingot.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8a5: The coal generator from chapter two won't even come close. And keep a buffer: when power runs low, the chamber doesn't queue up or print anything, it just stops working.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8ab: Power connected, the buffer is enough
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8bd: And this is where redstone becomes a problem before draconium does. One block is nine dust, twenty-six blocks are two hundred thirty-four. The &eCombiner&r makes the dust from iron oxide and strontium carbonate, and the rock is six tenths of a percent strontium: the tightest element in the whole early game, and absolutely everything hangs on it.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8cf: There's nothing to brew Fire Resistance from: there's no water here, and you've never seen a spider eye. Just armor, blocks and milk, if you have any.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8d7: Build the frame, light it and step through
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8dc: Tier three: twenty-six blocks, a full three-by-three cube minus the middle. One billion six hundred forty million: thirty-six times tier one, for twenty-six blocks.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8de: A port can take the place of any casing, but never the place of glass.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8e0: Ghasts hover over lava seas and in basalt deltas. Not every one drops a tear; Looting helps.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.8fa: Fusion goes up, fission goes down: together they close the table, and from any element you can get any other. All that's left is to collect all one hundred and eighteen.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.905: And count the stars. Every tier two injector has a Wyvern Core inside, meaning one more &eNether Star&r. Four injectors: four Withers. And the Draconic Core will need ten of them, one per ingredient.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.91e: One pylon in, one pylon out
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.932: Core in the center, injectors around it, each with its working side facing the core. Two to sixteen blocks away: no closer, and any farther it won't see the core.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.93a: Later germanium becomes free: sulfur plus sulfur gives exactly that, &b16&r + &b16&r = &b32&r. But you have to build the chamber for that first, and you need the powder now.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.93c: Yttrium is named after the Swedish village of Ytterby: four elements were pulled out of a single quarry next to it. That never happened anywhere else.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.93d: This isn't an &6Alchemistry&r chamber. There, what matters is what's inside; here, what matters is how it's arranged. Every cell looks at its neighbors, every heat sink checks its surroundings, and a reactor built from the right blocks in the wrong order simply doesn't work.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.942: Without it, energy crystals just sit there. The binder is the only way to tell a relay where to send power, and without it all of Draconic's wireless transfer looks like a pile of dead blocks you'll stare at and fume.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.950: Turn on semi-automatic shutdown before the first start
An atom every two and a half seconds
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.97b: Gravel matters most. Flint only comes from gravel, and flint and steel only from flint: the very one you were handed as a single piece for the whole portal. Now the &eCombiner&r builds gravel: crushed stone is silica with a bit of alumina and iron, so four silicon dioxide, aluminum oxide and iron oxide make four blocks.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.981: The Fusion Chamber Controller can't be bought or found. They give it out for a star, this one, the one you just brought back.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.998: Read this before you connect the first pipe
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.99f: Build a second Fusion Chamber instead of a schedule
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.9a8: Fusion: copper plus tin. Copper drops from White Antimatter, and after the diorite you have mountains of tin.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.9b6: &b3&r. Everything else in the walls: glass.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.9b9: From ten uranium dust the separator makes nine uranium-238 and one uranium-235. Nine tenths of your uranium is what the industry calls depleted.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.9cc: The capacitor rides in your pocket and charges anything that takes energy. In a pack where half the tools run on FE, it isn't a decoration but a way to stop running back to base every twenty minutes.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.9e4: Bad stories go around about a dozen controllers sitting on one shared bus: after that, the world may one day fail to load. Nobody has properly checked them, but nobody has disproved them either.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.9f6: A piglin takes a gold ingot and gives nothing back: there's no bartering in season two, the pack runs entirely on chemistry. In season one, gravel, pearls and obsidian came from right here.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.9fd: From here the Energy Core stops being a block and becomes a structure. Tier two is six draconium blocks around it, tier three twenty-six, tier eight thirteen by thirteen by thirteen. The block itself never changes: what changes is what's around it.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a06: This is the first point where the pack's two nuclear mods cross paths at all. Until now they've spent fifteen chapters doing the same thing without knowing about each other.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a12: Dust into the furnace, ingot out of the furnace. Nothing tricky; the tricky part starts later.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a13: Eighteen because a Fission Core is &b6&r ingots and &b3&r blaze rods, and you need three cores. A full set for the chapter six Fission Chamber, exactly, with nothing left over.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a17: Yes, another star. You gave the first one for the fusion controller; this one goes into the Wyvern Core, and the Wyvern Core sits inside everything else: the Energy Core, the capacitor, the reactor rotors, and the Draconic Core, which takes four at once.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a1f: Make a dozen at once. Recounting later, standing at the crafting table next to a half-built multiblock, is the worst way to find out how many you needed.

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a37: They only give the controller for this
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a44: Ender pearls drop from the endermen that roam the plain at night, and the &eCombiner&r builds them from silicon, neodymium and mercury. Obsidian has been built from atoms since chapter one.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a4e: Found a spawner? Don't break it
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a80: Got it: don't put many chambers on one bus
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.a88: Read where this branch runs into the next chapter
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.aa5: An Eye of Ender is a pearl plus blaze powder, and the Combiner builds pearls from silicon, neodymium and mercury. lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.aaa: Build the whole Fusion Chamber and start it up
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.aab: The peak of &6NuclearCraft&r and a line in the “Transcript: energy” of your &eCertificate&r.

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.af0: Remember the blaze rod quest saying sixteen would be just barely enough? Forget it. Four Particle Generators take another sixteen, and that's just for the Energy Core stabilizers. Go back to the fortress, or fence that spawner in properly.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.aff: This isn't decoration and it isn't a detail. A misplaced heat sink doesn't heat up, doesn't cool, and just takes up space. The reactor will still form and start, and you'll find out from the temperature.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.b02: Second chamber built and running its own recipe
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.b03: Make 26 draconium blocks and raise the Energy Core to tier three
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.b25: Four lapis blocks, four diamonds, a Draconium Core in the center. The Combiner builds lapis: silicon, sodium, mullite and calcium sulfide.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.b43: The chamber's buffer is one hundred thousand FE, six reactions in reserve. It won't hold more: beyond that, it eats exactly as much as the grid gives it.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.b5b: Four draconium ingots, four gold, and an &eEngineering Processor&r from &6AE2&r in the center. lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.b65: Dissolve netherrack. Germanium drops about once per twenty-seven blocks, so thirty-two of it will take close to a thousand.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.b92: The mod's numbers are honest in spirit. A low-enriched uranium assembly gives two hundred forty FE per tick and fifty heat, a highly enriched one nine hundred sixty and three hundred. Four times the energy, six times the heat. Heat is the whole gameplay here.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.b9c: There's no radiation on the server either, and with explosions off, a meltdown doesn't spill. But a dead reactor means downtime, and downtime here costs more than any crater.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.ba1: There are three types. The relay passes energy on down the chain, the I/O crystal gives and receives, and the wireless one works with no line at all: a pearl, a Particle Generator, an Eye of Ender and a relay inside.

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.bda: Costs pennies, gets lost instantly, gets remembered last. Make two.

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.be1: A moderator is a graphite or beryllium block placed right against a fuel cell. Each such contact adds about seventeen percent energy and about thirty-three percent heat to the cell.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.c00: The chamber adds up atomic numbers, and it has no other rule. Si is &b14&r, so the output is number &b28&r, which is nickel.

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.c15: “Output” in the block's name is about direction, not initiative. &6Alchemistry&r machines don't push anything anywhere on their own, and the reactor is no exception: you'll have to pull. lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.c51: Chemical Reactor, Chassis, doped silicon and elite plates. In this pack the two bottom plates are replaced with &6Mekanism&r ATOMIC ALLOY.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.c57: Five hundred and twelve carbons apiece

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.c65: A Looting sword, or it takes a week
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.c68: Craft a Flux Plug and a Flux Point

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.c83: Iron, a Potentiometer, two redstone blocks, a Draconium Core, a comparator.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.c8c: The Fusion Chamber has exactly two inputs. It won't add up three elements. But an element with itself, it will: silicon plus silicon has already given you nickel.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.c95: In real life depleted uranium has the same biography. Thousands of tons of it piled up as enrichment waste, and then uses were found for its density: ballast, armor, penetrator cores. It stopped being waste, but not because it became safe.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.ca8: So the loop is broken at diorite. Diorite is a feldspar rock: the &eCombiner&r builds two blocks from six silicon dioxide, aluminum oxide, sodium and calcium. Sixty-four blocks is just a warm-up.

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.ced: Estimate how many atoms an hour one chamber puts out
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.cf1: Magma blocks sit along the shores of lava lakes, and only with Silk Touch, or they'll crumble. Basalt is there too, in columns.

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.d13: &b5&r. The controller right against the top core, facing outward.

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.d3b: A heat sink that sinks nothing

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.d69: This is the first mob farm of the whole game. Bones, gunpowder, arrows, string, experience: everything the white plain never had and never could have starts here.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.d7b: Three hundred twenty-eight blocks of redstone is two thousand nine hundred fifty-two dust, so roughly as many Combiner operations. By this point automation isn't something to talk about anymore, it's a precondition.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.d7d: Injectors follow the &6Ad Astra&r planets: tier two wants desh from the Moon, tier three ostrum from Mars, tier four calorite from Venus. Each next step of the mod waits for the next rocket.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.d84: The &eCombiner&r builds it from six uranium atoms and sixteen oxygen. The rock is ten percent oxygen, so it's practically free. Work out for yourself what pays better to run through the separator.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.d94: While you're at it, look at what else got cheaper: sulfur plus sulfur gives germanium, aluminum plus iron gives yttrium, sodium plus hydrogen gives magnesium for new portals. lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.d9b: Four redstone blocks, four blaze rods, a Draconium Core in the center.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.db5: Tier eight: thirteen by thirteen by thirteen, seven hundred eighty-six draconium blocks and three hundred seventy-eight awakened draconium blocks. Its capacity isn't written in the config as a number, but as a sign that the numbers ran out.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.dce: Tier seven capacity: two trillion one hundred forty billion FE. Compare that with tier one's forty-five million. Between them lie six steps and two hundred ten draconium blocks, and not a single new recipe: the Energy Core grows by quantity alone.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.dec: An injector's tier must be no lower than the recipe's tier, and charge time is set by the lowest one in the ring. The Draconium one charges for fifteen seconds, the Chaotic one for three. One cheap piece of junk in the ring slows down the whole circle.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.df6: Craft the Draconic Evolution Fusion Crafting Core
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e05: Check three things before you start cursing. The stabilizers face the core and stand symmetrically. lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e09: There is a recipe after all, but the price is the same: steel, Reactor Casing, Reactor Glass and one more star in the middle. lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e0e: A utility quest. It's for one case only: the “netherstar” stage was supposed to arrive as a reward, but didn't.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e3a: The second reactor is almost free
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e56: By now you should have a proper Wither arena, not a one-off box. Printing stars in the Combiner is cheaper than farming them, but lutetium lives in the End, and the End is the next chapter. For now: skulls.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e64: &6NuclearCraft&r: Neoteric. Its whole alloy tree is bridged to elements in this pack: steel, stainless steel, ferroboron, zircaloy, silicon carbide, magnesium diboride, forty recipes, each with its own formula.

Uranium-&b238&r catches a neutron in the reactor and, after two beta decays, becomes plutonium-&b239&r, which is fissile and practically absent in nature. That's where all the plutonium on the planet comes from: it isn't mined, it's accumulated.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e87: From now on you have a buffer that holds your entire overnight output. The point of the Energy Core isn't capacity as such, it's that peak demand no longer brings production down: the Fusion Chamber, the fission reactor and fusion crafting can all start at once, and none of them will quietly stop.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e8c: Or open the “Alchemistry Labs Catalogue” to the Fusion Multiblock page, hover and hold the button: the blocks will show up as ghosts in their places.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e99: Cu = &b29&r, Sn = &b50&r, and &b79&r is gold. For four hundred years alchemists got bronze out of these same two metals: they mixed them, you add them up.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.e9c: Plan for a hundred right away

lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.ec5: The Nether's ceiling and the vaults over lava lakes. Breaks by hand, crumbles into dust; Silk Touch keeps the block whole.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.ecb: Quartz was needed for one thing. Cobblestone and quartz make diorite, diorite and cobblestone make andesite, and from those the Dissolver pulls the osmium and platinum for your first Fusion Chamber. Quartz itself can now only be built from silica and barium, and barium only comes from fusion, meaning that very chamber. A loop.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.edc: Quartz could have been sticking out of the Nether's walls in whole clusters. In season two there is no ore in any world, and the Nether is no exception: there's nothing to mine here, and everything is still built from atoms.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.edd: From this moment the periodic table stops being a reference chart and becomes a recipe list: any two elements make a third.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.ee1: Hence a useful habit: look not at what you need to get, but at what's already sitting in storage by the ton. Iron, carbon, silicon, calcium and copper are infinite for you. Everything else is derived from them, and chain length matters more than rarity.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.eea: After the second reactor, casings stopped being a problem: osmium and platinum now take two recipes instead of fifteen thousand blocks of andesite. So count like this: as many different elements as you need on the line, that many chambers you build. Each with its own chest, its own filter, its own cable.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.efa: Four chapters of the white plain: no sky, no horizon, not a single sound. There was no way to get here, so you synthesized the entrance.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f04: Draconium is built in the &eCombiner&r: eight neodymium, four thorium and four protactinium per dust. lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f0f: &b2&r. The four corner columns: casing too.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f10: The generator itself produces nothing: it holds the field. It goes into Energy Core stabilizers and wireless crystals, and you don't need it anywhere else.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f1c: Tier four: fifty-four draconium blocks outside, twenty-six redstone blocks inside. Nine billion eight hundred eighty million.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f20: Fusion takes two elements and gives one. Fission is the reverse: one in, two out, and both land in the same output port.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f31: &eCombiner&r: &b14&r zirconium, &b1&r tin, &b1&r iron. Zirconium comes from cobblestone, one and a half percent per block, and your cobblestone is infinite.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f36: &6Flux Networks&r moves energy without wires: from a generator to a machine across the whole base, and even into another world. It generates nothing itself: whatever goes into the network is what comes out.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f4f: Gather 26 redstone blocks for tier four
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f57: Place 8 Water Heat Sinks by the rules
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.f6a: All the lead in the world
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.fc2: Thirty-two thousand is less than your generator puts out in a minute. Remember that number. The next injector tier costs two hundred fifty-six thousand, the Draconic Core a million, an Awakened Draconium Block fifty million. The scale here was never linear.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.fc8: Place the receptacle and open a Draconic portal
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.fd2: &aThis quest unlocks the “Periodic Table”, “Nether and End” and “Draconic Evolution” chapters.&r
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.fd4: Four blocks of soul sand in a T, three skulls on top. Build it inside an obsidian box or right in the Nether's bedrock ceiling: the Wither will tear down everything else.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.fd8: Fission is fusion in reverse: the chamber takes one element and cuts its atomic number in half. Uranium (&b92&r) gives two palladium, chromium (&b24&r) two magnesium, gold (&b79&r) zirconium and yttrium. For odd numbers the halves differ by one.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.fdf: The composition is real, down to the last percent. Zircaloy is used for fuel rod cladding in every light-water reactor in the world, because zirconium barely absorbs neutrons. There's a flip side: above &b900&r °C it strips oxygen from steam and releases hydrogen. At Fukushima it was this hydrogen that exploded, not the reactor.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.fe3: Core in the center, four stabilizers on the axes, two pylons nearby. Switch one pylon to input, leave the other on output, and cable both into your grid.
lanminecraft.reforged.quests.05_core.fea: Got it: two inputs, everything else is chains

A hundred and eighteen identical little boxes of a thousand each is, if you think about it, the universe turned inside out. In the real one, hydrogen and helium make up &b98&r%% of all matter, and everything else together is two percent, which astronomers lump under one word for simplicity: metals. There's plenty of oxygen because it's easy to assemble in stars; there's almost no gold or uranium because they're made only in catastrophes. You, meanwhile, pay the same for hydrogen as for iridium. Nature can't do that.

One electron in the outer shell, and the farther it is from the nucleus, the weaker its grip. Hence a rule you can see with the naked eye. Lithium fizzes in water. Sodium races across the surface as a burning ball. Potassium sets fire to the hydrogen it gives off, all by itself. Cesium shatters the glass tank with a shock wave.

In &b1871&r Mendeleev did something nobody had done before him: he left empty squares in the table and wrote down what the elements that would fill them would be like. Not “something will turn up”, but numbers: atomic weight, density, the formulas of the oxides and chlorides, even the way the element would be discovered.
White arsenic has no taste or smell, dissolves in wine and produces symptoms just like cholera. In Europe, for several centuries, it was called exactly that: inheritance powder.

Blame the nucleus's bookkeeping: an element with an odd number of protons can't have two stable neighbors by mass, and for numbers &b43&r and &b61&r the neighboring spots were taken long ago, by molybdenum and ruthenium and by neodymium and samarium. There's simply nowhere left to stand.

Then it got worse. In the twenties, radium paint went on glowing watch hands, and the factory girls pointed their brushes with their lips: that way the paint went on more evenly. The whole of modern labor law on occupational disease grew out of the “Radium Girls” case. Before it, it was the dying worker who had to prove the employer was at fault.
